items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: my oldest daughter, Mildred, she was a small child

ctx.x: But did you live there all the time or just for the summers?

No, you see, my family and I, we were minding a club, and regalese, and I was a club, and regalese, you know? And uh, my oldest daughter, Mildred, she was a small child, she was taken with terrible fever from mosquito bites, and the doctor ordered me to take her, thought probably she had some lung trouble or something, to bring her over there in his party. But my father was over in that neighborhood, so I just brought her. Well I joined the Black Eagles band, and I played with Leonard Parker, and uh, uh, Fritz…
When you came back over here, you worked with Billy and the Dee some, didn't you?
